result.reason: The redline materially approaches the preferred position by permitting Sparkling assignments to affiliates and M&A successors without consent, applying a reasonableness standard to other assignments, and preventing Garman from terminating following Sparkling's assignment or change of control. However, it omits the required absolute prohibition on assignment by Garman to a Sparkling competitor. In addition, the revision to subsection (c) grammatically permits transfer, lease, export, or sublicensing of the Work to affiliates and successors—not merely assignment of the Agreement—thereby altering unrelated restrictions more broadly than necessary. The added suspension and repricing language also exceeds the stated rule, though it is directionally protective.
